data.name: Helen

weaponImprint.name: Dulcet Defender
weaponImprint.trait: Physical damage taken is reduced by 8%.
weaponImprint.effect: The user's defense is increased by 15%/20%/25%/30%/35%/40% and damage from basic attack is increased by 25%/30%/35%/40%/45%/50%. At the end of the action, recovers HP by 5% of Max HP.
weaponImprint.imprintDescription: Damage to Sycca Tech units is increased by 2.5%. If the target has Freeze debuffs, this damage is further increased by 2.5%.

data.effects: Gentle in appearance, and extremely skilled at utilizing rules, adept at achieving desired goals through certain loopholes. Possesses extraordinary insight, always able to see through the essence of people's hearts beyond their surface behaviors. When interacting with those around her, she occasionally uses playful pranks to draw closer to others, guiding those who haven't realized their own feelings to epiphanies, and helping them overcome their weaknesses. In critical moments, she is also willing to sacrifice herself to protect the important people around her.

skills.name: Guardian
skills.description: Selects one enemy target within 6 tiles and deals Freeze damage equal to 80% of attack to them.

skills.name: Fearless Valkyrie
skills.description:
Immune to effects including: reducing healing received, preventing being healed, and converting healing to damage.

At the start of battle, Helen's defense and Max HP are increased by 30%.

At the start of turn, Helen gains 2 points of Confectance Index, recovers HP equal to 25% of Max HP and cleanse all debuffs.

For each instance of damage taken, Helen gains 1 stack of [effect:8cc23ef7-8a65-4a10-a967-73d8a9965537|doll:helen]. When Helen has [effect:8cc23ef7-8a65-4a10-a967-73d8a9965537|doll:helen], her basic attack damage multiplier is increased to 180%. Before making a basic attack, Helen increases her attack by 15% of her defense.
skills.descriptionLevel2:
Immune to effects including: reducing healing received, preventing being healed, and converting healing to damage.

At the start of battle, Helen's defense and Max HP are increased by 30%, her maximum stability is increased to 16 points, and damage taken is reduced by 50%.

At the start of turn, Helen gains 2 points of Confectance Index, recovers HP equal to 25% of Max HP and cleanse all debuffs.

For each instance of damage taken, Helen gains 2 stacks of [effect:8cc23ef7-8a65-4a10-a967-73d8a9965537|doll:helen]. When Helen has [effect:8cc23ef7-8a65-4a10-a967-73d8a9965537|doll:helen], her basic attack damage multiplier is increased to 180%. Before making a basic attack, Helen increases her attack by 30% of her defense.
skills.descriptionLevel3:
Immune to effects including: reducing healing received, preventing being healed, and converting healing to damage.

At the start of battle, Helen's defense and Max HP are increased by 30%, her maximum stability is increased to 16 points, and damage taken is reduced by 50%.

At the start of turn, Helen gains 2 points of Confectance Index, recovers HP equal to 25% of Max HP and cleanse all debuffs.

For each instance of damage taken by herself or any allied units, Helen gains 2 stacks of [effect:8cc23ef7-8a65-4a10-a967-73d8a9965537|doll:helen]. When Helen has [effect:8cc23ef7-8a65-4a10-a967-73d8a9965537|doll:helen], her basic attack damage multiplier is increased to 300%. Before making a basic attack, Helen increases her attack by 70% of her defense.

vertebraeUpgradeLevel2.effect:
Helen's maximum stability is increased to 16 points and damage taken is reduced by 50%.

For each instance of damage taken, Helen gains 1 additional stack of [effect:8cc23ef7-8a65-4a10-a967-73d8a9965537|doll:helen]. Before making a basic attack, Helen increases her attack by 30% of her defense.

vertebraeUpgradeLevel3.effect:
When an allied unit takes damage, gain 2 stacks of [effect:8cc23ef7-8a65-4a10-a967-73d8a9965537|doll:helen].

When Helen has [effect:8cc23ef7-8a65-4a10-a967-73d8a9965537|doll:helen], basic attack damage multiplier is increased to 300%. Before making a basic attack, Helen increases her attack by 70% of her defense.

skills.name: Maternal Care
skills.description:
Selects one allied unit within 6 tiles, applies [effect:46f8c242-d465-4bd2-b5ae-aa9543342fc3|doll:helen] to it to share damage with it, and removes [effect:fadf4f3f-2810-49f0-b947-6d683741429d] and [effect:e82fca4c-de4a-40b6-83c2-e84d716f72d3] from it. A maximum of 1 instance of [effect:46f8c242-d465-4bd2-b5ae-aa9543342fc3|doll:helen] can exist at one time.

Gains [effect:c1feeb2a-d9a9-4a73-9703-8806ee8cb9eb] after using this skill.
skills.descriptionLevel2:
Selects one allied unit within 6 tiles, applies [effect:46f8c242-d465-4bd2-b5ae-aa9543342fc3|doll:helen] to it to share damage with it, and removes [effect:fadf4f3f-2810-49f0-b947-6d683741429d], [effect:e82fca4c-de4a-40b6-83c2-e84d716f72d3], [effect:b46e4270-c2d5-4f69-bb9b-544785785790], and [effect:dd0752a2-37c4-47ba-91ad-2dc640d2372b] from it. A maximum of 1 instance of [effect:46f8c242-d465-4bd2-b5ae-aa9543342fc3|doll:helen] can exist at one time.

If Helan takes fatal damage in the process of sharing damage, she will not die but instead recover HP equal to 150% of defense. This effect can trigger up to 1 time per round.

Gains [effect:c1feeb2a-d9a9-4a73-9703-8806ee8cb9eb] after using this skill.

vertebraeUpgradeLevel2.effect:
Additionally removes[effect:b46e4270-c2d5-4f69-bb9b-544785785790] and [effect:dd0752a2-37c4-47ba-91ad-2dc640d2372b] from the selected allied unit.

If Helen takes fatal damage in the process of sharing damage, she will not die but instead recovers HP equal to 150% of defense. This effect can be trigger up to 1 time per round.

Freeze damage dealt by allied units with [effect:46f8c242-d465-4bd2-b5ae-aa9543342fc3|doll:helen] is increased by 30%.

skills.name: Covering Charge
skills.description:
Selects one tile within a cross-shaped area of 4 to 8 tiles, lands on the selected tile, cleanses 1 debuff from all allies in a 5-tile-wide area along the path, and applies [effect:abce6753-fe29-4ca3-b487-7453e982b279] for 2 turns. The value of the [effect:abce6753-fe29-4ca3-b487-7453e982b279] is 100% of Helen's initial attack, to a maximum of 100% of the target's Max HP. This skill also generates [effect:3c3d2b25-6823-4ce4-a33e-cf69e0e759a5] tiles in the effective area for 2 turns.

For each allied unit along the path (excluding Helen herself), the value of the Shield applied by this skill is increased by 30% and Helen recovers 2 points of stability. After this skill, Helen gains 6 tiles of [effect:1b83587d-eddc-4abd-b90c-cb0aa4b2cfef] and can use her basic attack.
skills.descriptionLevel2:
Selects one tile within a cross-shaped area of 4 to 8 tiles, lands on the selected tile, cleanses 3 debuffs from all allies in a 7-tile-wide area along the path, and applies [effect:9e535672-e66c-435a-a079-4c9fb3ee78d4] and [effect:abce6753-fe29-4ca3-b487-7453e982b279] for 2 turns. The value of the [effect:9e535672-e66c-435a-a079-4c9fb3ee78d4] (See Dandegate Note) [effect:abce6753-fe29-4ca3-b487-7453e982b279] is 100% of Helen's initial attack, to a maximum of 100% of the target's Max HP. This skill also generates [effect:3c3d2b25-6823-4ce4-a33e-cf69e0e759a5] tiles in the effective area for 2 turns.

For each allied unit along the path (excluding Helen herself), the value of the Shield applied by this skill is increased by 30% and Helen recovers 2 points of stability. After this skill, Helen gains 6 tiles of [effect:1b83587d-eddc-4abd-b90c-cb0aa4b2cfef] and can use her basic attack.
